Reranking where Fireworks lists the scored documents under data

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import RerankRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = RerankRequest.from_json("{\"documents\":[\"The weather is sunny today.\",\"Deep learning uses neural networks.\",\"Machine learning is a subset of AI.\"],\"model\":\"fireworks_ai/rerank-x\",\"query\":\"What is machine learning?\"}")
    result = await client.rerank(req)
    print(result.results)
    print(result.results[0].relevance_score)

asyncio.run(main())
```
